visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of related article cards built from authored links, enriched from the linked pages
traits: three cards per row at desktop, two at tablet, stacked on mobile
large light title; the whole card is one link

contentPattern.structure: 1 or 2 columns, one row per related article: cell 1 (optional) the card image, cell 2 a link to the article (link text = card title) and optionally a byline paragraph 'date | reading time | author' (printed as authored). Rows may also hold several links / a list (one card per link, without authored image or byline). Cards keep the authored order, duplicates are dropped. Whatever a row leaves out (image, byline, title when the link text is the URL) is read at runtime from the head of the linked page, for pages of this site only: og:image, publication-date (formatted per page language, e.g. 'August 20, 2026' / '20. August 2026'), reading-time, author, og:title (cached per tab in sessionStorage). Articles outside the site (www.lufthansa.com links) show only the authored values, so the importer writes image and byline for every card. Links to pages of the site are made relative; no link opens a new tab (as on lufthansa.com). Empty bylines take no space; titles are cut after three lines. The section heading ('Related Articles') stays default content above the block. No options.

usage: End of every insights article page (/de/en/articles/...), e.g. /de/en/articles/explore-the-world/eat-see-do-berlin.
reuseGuidance: Use wherever article pages are teased by link. Pages of the site need og:image, publication-date, reading-time and author metadata; other targets need the image and byline authored in the row. Listing pages (overview, category, tag, author) need a future query mode.
